title: Dental-Medical Terminology
html: Dr. Sandhu and colleagues deserve credit for attempting to consolidate cardiovascular, pulmonary, hepatic, kidney, endocrine, and oncological guidance into 1 reference for dentists in their July JADA article titled “Medical Clearance Considerations for Medically Complex Adult Patients” (Sandhu S, Newsome L, Shazib MA. JADA. 2026;157[7]:716-726. doi:10.1016/j.adaj.2025.11.017). The article nonetheless inherits a structural problem from the literature it reviews: medical clearance and provider are imprecise terms that undermine the communication the 2 professions need.
